name: bioinfo-bench_preprocess
description:
Bioinfo Bench Preprocessed Dataset
	

This dataset is a pre-processed and automatically evaluated version ofQiyuan04/bioinfo-bench.

	
		
		Pre-processing Summary
	


Flexible loading – handled inconsistent columns with pandas.
Fix missing answers – inferred Correct Answer from "Option D" when necessary.
Filter invalid rows – kept only rows whose answer ∈ {A, B, C, D}.
Format options – prefixed each choice with A:, B:, … .
Combine for SFT – joined question + options into question;… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LLMcompe-Team-Watanabe/bioinfo-bench_preprocess.
reputation: A Hugging Face preprocessed split of a domain-specific bioinformatics QA dataset; used mainly for SFT/evaluation in niche communities.
